exercises.title: I/O 1 — Programmed I/O, interrupts, DMA and I/O addressing
exercises.problemHtml:
Concept questions on the three I/O techniques.

This set has 5 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the CEA201 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# I/O 1 — Programmed I/O, interrupts, DMA and I/O addressing — answer key

1. In programmed (polling) I/O the processor …Trong I/O lập trình (thăm dò) bộ xử lý …
   Answer: c) repeatedly tests the device status until it is ready, wasting CPU time
   Busy-waiting keeps the CPU occupied for the whole transfer.VI: Chờ bận khiến CPU bị chiếm suốt lần truyền.

2. With interrupt-driven I/O the processor …Với I/O điều khiển bằng ngắt, bộ xử lý …
   Answer: d) can do other work while the device is busy, but still moves every word itself
   The device interrupts when ready; the CPU still executes the transfer instructions.VI: Thiết bị ngắt khi sẵn sàng; CPU vẫn thực hiện lệnh chuyển dữ liệu.

3. DMA is best suited for …DMA phù hợp nhất với …
   Answer: a) large block transfers such as disk and network traffic
   The DMA controller moves blocks between device and memory and interrupts once at the end.VI: Bộ điều khiển DMA chuyển khối giữa thiết bị và bộ nhớ và chỉ ngắt một lần ở cuối.

4. In memory-mapped I/O …Trong I/O ánh xạ bộ nhớ …
   Answer: a) device registers share the memory address space and are accessed by ordinary load/store
   It removes the need for special I/O instructions but uses up memory addresses.VI: Không cần lệnh I/O riêng nhưng tiêu tốn địa chỉ bộ nhớ.

5. “Cycle stealing” by a DMA controller means …“Cycle stealing” của bộ điều khiển DMA nghĩa là …
   Answer: a) it takes over the bus for single memory cycles, delaying the CPU slightly
   The CPU and DMA share the bus; DMA gets individual cycles.VI: CPU và DMA dùng chung bus; DMA chiếm từng chu kỳ.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Answer key / Đáp án

  1. c) repeatedly tests the device status until it is ready, wasting CPU time

    Busy-waiting keeps the CPU occupied for the whole transfer.

    VI: Chờ bận khiến CPU bị chiếm suốt lần truyền.

  2. d) can do other work while the device is busy, but still moves every word itself

    The device interrupts when ready; the CPU still executes the transfer instructions.

    VI: Thiết bị ngắt khi sẵn sàng; CPU vẫn thực hiện lệnh chuyển dữ liệu.

  3. a) large block transfers such as disk and network traffic

    The DMA controller moves blocks between device and memory and interrupts once at the end.

    VI: Bộ điều khiển DMA chuyển khối giữa thiết bị và bộ nhớ và chỉ ngắt một lần ở cuối.

  4. a) device registers share the memory address space and are accessed by ordinary load/store

    It removes the need for special I/O instructions but uses up memory addresses.

    VI: Không cần lệnh I/O riêng nhưng tiêu tốn địa chỉ bộ nhớ.

  5. a) it takes over the bus for single memory cycles, delaying the CPU slightly

    The CPU and DMA share the bus; DMA gets individual cycles.

    VI: CPU và DMA dùng chung bus; DMA chiếm từng chu kỳ.

exercises.title: I/O 2 — How much CPU does an 8 MB/s stream cost?
exercises.problemHtml:
A device streams 8 MB/s (8 × 10⁶ bytes per second) into memory on a 2 GHz CPU. Compute the share of the CPU consumed by each technique (%, 2 decimals; polling occupies the CPU 100 % while the transfer runs).

This set has 1 table. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the CEA201 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: I/O 4 — Memory-mapped I/O: read the address map
exercises.problemHtml:
A 16-bit system uses memory-mapped I/O. Map: 0000–BFFF RAM, C000–EFFF ROM, F000–FFFF device registers. For each address say which region it belongs to; then give how many bytes of address space are consumed by ROM + I/O.

This set has 2 tables. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the CEA201 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Bộ này có 2 bảng. Không có gì để chạy: trả lời trong khung bên phải rồi bấm Nộp. Câu hỏi theo phong cách đề FE của môn CEA201, nên hãy giải ra giấy trước như khi ngồi phòng thi.
